name: unwrap-folder
title: Unwrap Folder
description: Flatten one or more selected Finder folders by moving their contents up one level, and wrap a selection into a new folder.
author: Fredrik-psd

commands.name: unwrap-folder
commands.title: Unwrap Folder
commands.description: Move a selected Finder folder's contents up one level and delete the folder

commands.name: unwrap-folder-deep
commands.title: Unwrap Folder Deeply
commands.description: Repeat unwrap up to N levels — useful for archives extracted with multiple wrapper folders

commands.name: wrap-folder
commands.title: Wrap into Folder
commands.description: Move the selected Finder items into a new folder you name

preferences.name: skipConfirmation
preferences.title: Confirmation
preferences.label: Skip the confirmation dialog for Unwrap Folder
preferences.description: When on, Unwrap Folder runs immediately without asking. Unwrap Folder Deeply always confirms.

preferences.name: disposableEntries
preferences.title: Disposable Entries
preferences.description: Comma-separated names safe to delete from an otherwise-empty folder before trashing it (e.g. .DS_Store, Thumbs.db, .localized).
